title: Route Me If You Can: A Benchmark for Query Reformulation Selection
abstract: arXiv:2609.14885v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based query reformulation can improve retrieval, but no single reformulation strategy is consistently optimal across queries, domains, retrievers, or model backbones. This creates an inference-time decision problem: ``Given an original query and a pool of candidate reformulations, which one should be issued to the retriever?''. Existing studies are hard to compare because they use different reformulator pools, retrievers, relevance signals, training labels, and evaluation metrics. We introduce QueryRoute, a benchmark that freezes the expensive artifacts needed to study this decision reproducibly: original queries, generated variants, ranked lists under multiple retrievers, retrieval scores, and per-query oracle labels. The benchmark contains 3,757 queries, 11 candidate systems, five reformulator backbones, and three retrievers across TREC DL, BEIR, and BRIGHT, yielding 619,905 retrieval outcomes. translated_title: 有本事就来路由我：查询重写选择基准测试
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的查询重写可以提升检索效果，但没有任何单一的重写策略能够在所有查询、领域、检索器或模型骨干上都始终保持最优。这就产生了一个推理时的决策问题：“给定一个原始查询和一个候选重写池，应该将哪一个提交给检索器？”。由于现有研究使用不同的重写器池、检索器、相关性信号、训练标签和评估指标，因此难以相互比较。我们提出了QueryRoute基准，它冻结了以可复现方式研究这一决策所需的昂贵资源：原始查询、生成的变体、多个检索器下的排序列表、检索得分以及每个查询的oracle标签。该基准包含3,757个查询、11个候选系统、五个重写器骨干和三个检索器，覆盖TREC DL、BEIR和BRIGHT数据集，共产生619,905个检索结果。我们对该决策问题上的有监督分类方法进行了基准评测。
tldr: 该论文提出了QueryRoute基准，通过冻结原始查询、候选重写、多种检索器的检索结果和oracle标签等昂贵资源，首次系统性地支持对“推理时如何从候选池中选择最优查询重写”这一决策问题的可复现研究。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces QueryRoute, a benchmark that freezes expensive artifacts (queries, generated variants, retrieval outcomes, and oracle labels) to enable reproducible study of the inference-time decision problem of selecting the optimal query reformulation from a candidate pool, covering 3,757 queries, 11 candidate systems, and 619,905 retrieval outcomes.
